Use case: stylized-concept. Original transparent PNG sprite atlas for a Minecraft Cobblemon quest book. ONE square perfectly regular invisible 4x4 grid, exactly 16 isolated equidistant sprites. Each horizontal ROW has ONE different subject repeated as four coherent animation frames. Read left to right, next row below. Four columns and four rows all equally spaced; centers x and y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Draw ORIGINAL expressive tiny pixel art of the recognizable species described, never tracing an existing official sprite. Each depicted subject lives entirely within the middle 70% of its own equal square cell, fully visible tips, broad transparent gutters all around. Individual portraits or compact busts with clean deliberately simplified shapes, bright highlights for a dark inventory screen, scaled-up chunky 1px navy outline and 2-4px important color clusters on a conceptual 32px grid. Selective light edges, sharp squared pixels, vibrant flat 8-12 color palettes per creature. Transparent background in every cell, absolutely no tiles, labels, words, numbers, borders, stands, shadows, glow clouds or scattered detail. Same size, direction, pose, body shape and anchor across each row; change only a subtle LOCAL detail and keep four perceptibly different frames. Use the following distinct subjects top to bottom:
1. Ogerpon — Small green ogre wearing its distinctive teal leaf mask with orange star eyes, sprouting twig horns and green cloak. One eye twinkles and the tip of a leaf shifts.
2. Wo-Chien — Ancient dark olive snail face framed by a shell composed of stacked curled brown wooden tablets, mossy leaf crest and short yellow eye stalks. One leaf dips then springs back.
3. Chien-Pao — Pale blue-white saber cat head in profile, two very long black broken blade fangs, violet-gold eye and lilac ear inside. Cold white glint travels down the foreground blade.
4. Ting-Lu — Dark earthy moose head under a big broken bronze ceremonial vessel shaped as antlers, with two incised rims and dark green ear. A bronze rim reflects light left to right.
Create the specified four rows, four animation frames per row. Make each row visually distinct and each changing detail obvious at small size.
